# PtrIsErr

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Tells whether a pointer returned by MemMap() or MemMapAnon() is an error.

!!! info "Library helper"
    Implemented in `zuzu.h` on top of the syscalls; it has no syscall number of its own.

```c
int PtrIsErr(const void *p);
```

Those calls return either an address or a negative [Err](../errors.md#err) cast to a pointer; the error range is the top 4095 bytes of the address space.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `p` | in | Pointer to test. |

## Returns

Non-zero if `p` encodes an error; recover it with `(Err)(intptr_t)p`.
